says: The p33 recovery law was red once in ten runs at the same head, after 115 s instead of about 50 s, and the run left an orphaned workerd (parent pid 1); the tests step saw an unexplained red of the same file's real-instance laws after about 72 s.
proof: nice -n 19 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 next/apps/fabrika/src/instance-one-file.integration.test.ts printed 'Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)', 'Duration 115.55s', with the failure at line 792; ps then showed a workerd started 67 s into that run with ppid 1; the next nine runs printed 'Tests 7 passed (7)'. Second sighting: field/runs/2026-11-16-mock-app-src-s2-tests1.json note.
cost: A merge-line or scheduled run of this file goes red for no code reason, and a leaked workerd holds a port for later runs.
